rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-09-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A CONTINUING NATIONWIDE INFORMATION CAMPAIGN FOR THE PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF HEPATITIS-B AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Aims to target the 60% of the population living in the rural areas where the information campaign on the control and prevention of Hepatitis B is badly needed.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-09-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE MINIMUM WAGE OF HOUSEHELPERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Seeks to INCREASE the salaries of househelpers from [P800.00] to TWO THOUSAND PESOS (P2,000.00).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-09-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A SPECIAL PRIVILEGE TO HONOR GRADUATES OF STATE UNIVERSITIES AND COLLEGES IN THE RECRUITMENT AND SELECTION OF EMPLOYEES TO ENTER THE GOVERNMENT SERVICES
rows.abstract: "Honor Graduates Priority Act of 1998". Declares that all students who graduate with honors from State universities and colleges shall receive AUTOMATIC civil service eligibility as of the date of their graduation. Any willful violation of this Actshall be penalized.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 1998-09-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING REGIONAL CONSULTANCY SERVICE OFFICES OF THE CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The establishment of such consultancy offices aims to assure the retirable and retired employees of the CSC's continued assistance.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 1998-09-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING AS WATERSHED AREAS ALL RIVERS OF AT LEAST TWO KILOMETERS LONG WITH THE SURROUNDING RIVER BANKS MEASURING ONE HUNDRED HECTARES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: States that all rivers of at least two (2) kilometers long with the surrounding river banks measuring 100 hectares are DECLARED WATERSHED AREAS.  The same shall be protected under RA 7586, the National Integrated Protected Areas System Act of 1992.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1998-09-28
